utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can start around 9. I just need to pick up a few things first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring anything from the store?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can lend a hand with that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. Thanks, Gus, I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, I’ll bring the tools and we can get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up this week. Folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but I hope they’ve got enough vans and a place to sort everything before the pile gets out of hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I’m hearing that too. They’ve got a second van lined up, and the church hall is being cleared for sorting this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still need the basement light, the front screen door, and the loose handrail checked.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check those three right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading over with the invitation list now - if you know anyone who can help with the repair drive, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can ask around, though I’m not sure I can help much myself right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, that helps. Even a few names would make a difference, so ask whoever comes to mind and I’ll follow up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’ll coordinate the next steps so we can keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Let me know what you need me to handle next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great. I need you to handle outreach to the volunteer list, and I’ll pin down the schedule and materials so we can keep the drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me what part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: The front panel by the east side is the part that needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll check the front panel on the east side next.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a big help, thanks. I’ll let you know if we still need you after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’ll be ready after pickup if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces, but I think the repair drive is still happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I think so. I heard it’s still on and they’re trying to line up more help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense. I heard they were still short on hands, so hopefully more people show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help, but I only caught part of that. What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? I just want to make sure I heard you right, because that sounds a little vague. What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repairs at the community hall. Mostly the roof and a few busted fixtures - I skimmed it too, but that's the gist.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the kitchen sink’s dripping and the porch light keeps flickering. I might’ve mixed up the order, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, let’s start with the sink and then look at the porch light after.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll keep telling folks so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I’ll keep track of what we’ve got and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word so nothing slips through the cracks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I haven’t gotten the latest on what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest either, but last I checked it was the wiring and one of the back windows still needing work.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like they’re down to the wiring and that back window now, which is better than it sounded before.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Vik, I might have missed a detail, but I’m here to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just need a hand loading the repair supplies and checking the list with me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I can help load the supplies and go over the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I missed the latest update, but I can help if you fill me in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can catch you up after dinner. It’s just a small list of repairs and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — after dinner, then. Just tell me what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring over my drill and extension cord for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, then we’re set. Let’s meet at nine and keep the work list tight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’ll be there at nine with the drill and cord.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can help with that. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send around the word and see who can swing by with tools or know-how. The drive’s for the broken gate latch, the loose porch step, and a couple of leaky taps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. Tell me what still needs a hand, and I can help line up a few more people.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the west side entrance and the loading dock; if you can get two more hands there, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll line up two more people for the west side entrance and loading dock right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ve got the repair drive list ready. Just tell me which house needs the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can take the first stop if you tell me which house is lowest on the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The lowest on the list is the Miller house on Pine Street, so let’s start there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I only caught bits of it. Did they say what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, they still need help with the wiring and a couple of leaky taps. I’m trying to get the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know. If you get the exact list, let me know — I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I really appreciate it. I’ll check the school schedule and let you know what day works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive is still on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still on.
